info.description:
Backend of the AYO Plant Copilot, an AI agent that guides industrial plant teams through
structured problem solving. This API loads the plant knowledge (procedures, manuals) the
copilot retrieves from.

## Authentication

The `/admin` endpoints need the header `X-API-Key`. In this page, click **Authorize** and
paste the key, then use **Try it out**. The key is **provisional**: one shared key, to be
replaced by real user identity and per-tenant permissions.

## Errors

Every error has the same body, the shape FastAPI uses for request validation errors:

```json
{"detail": [{"type": "file_empty", "loc": ["body", "file"], "msg": "file is empty"}]}
```

Branch on `type`, a stable code; `msg` is for humans. `loc` names the input at fault, or
is `[]`. Only FastAPI's own validation errors (such as `missing`) add `input` and `ctx`.

| `type` | Status | `loc` |
|---|---|---|
| `invalid_api_key` | 401 | `["header", "x-api-key"]` |
| `file_too_large` | 413 | `["body", "file"]` |
| `file_extension`, `file_encoding`, `file_empty`, `file_no_content` | 422 | `["body", "file"]` |
| `source_key_invalid` | 422 | `["body", "source_key"]` (`["body", "file"]` if derived) |
| FastAPI codes (`missing`, `string_pattern_mismatch`, `literal_error`, ...) | 422 | the field |
| `document_not_found` | 404 | `["path", "doc_id"]` |
| `embedding_failed` | 502 | `[]` |

Requests the framework rejects use the same body: a malformed body is `400 bad_request`,
an unknown path `404 not_found`, a wrong method `405 method_not_allowed`, and an
unexpected failure `500 internal_error`.

get.description:
List the stored documents, one page at a time, newest change first.

Filter by `tenant` and by `q`, a case-insensitive substring of the title or the source key
(`%` and `_` match themselves). `total` counts every match, so a client can page with
`offset` until it has `total` items; the order is stable across pages, even on ties.

Each item carries a `status` computed now against the current settings: `outdated` means
the chunking or embedding settings changed since the document was indexed.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | A page, possibly empty. |
| `401` | `X-API-Key` missing or wrong. |
| `422` | A query parameter is out of range or not allowed (FastAPI validation). |

post.description:
Index one Markdown file for a tenant, so the copilot can retrieve it.

The file is split into chunks along its headings (each chunk keeps its heading path),
each chunk is embedded, and the document, its Markdown and its chunks are stored in one
transaction. A document is identified by `tenant` + `source_key` (by default the file
name): uploading it again replaces its previous version.

**Idempotent.** If the content and the chunking and embedding settings are the same as
the stored version, nothing is done and the answer is `200 up_to_date`, without calling
the embedding provider. Send `force=true` to reindex anyway.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Indexed (new document, or a changed one). |
| `200` | Already up to date: nothing was done. |
| `401` | `X-API-Key` missing or wrong. |
| `413` | The file is larger than `MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES` (default 5 MiB). |
| `422` | Not a `.md` file, not UTF-8, empty, nothing to index, or an invalid field. |
| `502` | The embedding provider failed after retries. Nothing was stored. |

Errors use the API's error format (see the API description) and are told apart by
`detail[].type`.

200.description: Already up to date: same content and settings, nothing was done.

201.description: Indexed: the document was chunked, embedded and stored.

422.description: The file or a field is not acceptable. `type` is one of `file_extension`, `file_encoding`, `file_empty`, `file_no_content`, `source_key_invalid`, or a FastAPI validation code such as `missing` or `string_pattern_mismatch`.

502.description: The embedding provider failed after retries. Nothing was stored; retrying later is safe.
